item.title: 0.8.3-beta.1
item.description:
Aki 0.8.3 beta 1

New

  • The Claude app's Code sessions show on the sidebar like terminals, and marks sent to one go into it in the app.
  • With more than one display, right-click the sidebar → Screen to choose where the bar lives.

Fixed

  • The sidebar no longer hides under the Dock.

Aki 0.8.2

Fixed

  • The rings' numbers go in order (1, 2, 3…) without skipping the sessions kept in "+N", and ⌘1, ⌘2… while marking follow the same numbers.
  • "Connect" also connects the Claude app's Code tab for people who don't have Claude Code installed separately.

item.title: 0.8.2-beta.1
item.description:
Aki 0.8.2 beta 1

Fixed

  • The rings' numbers go in order (1, 2, 3…) without skipping, and ⌘1, ⌘2… while marking follow them.
  • "Connect" also connects the Claude app's Code tab when there is no claude command.

Aki 0.8.1

New

  • Claude's limits ring now shows for people who use the Claude app and not Claude Code.
  • A limits ring shows as soon as Aki sees Claude or Codex, empty until its numbers come, and right after "Connect".
  • Settings → Agents → "What Aki found": whether Aki sees the Claude and Codex apps, their terminals and their limits, with "Search again". Also on a limits ring's right-click menu.

Lighter

  • Less work with many terminals open.

Aki 0.8.0

Faster, lighter

  • Aki no longer slows the Mac down: apps it looked into while you marked (Chrome, the Claude and ChatGPT apps) go back to normal afterwards, and Aki does far less in the background.
  • Marking opens at once, like the Mac's own screenshot.

New

  • "Wake the agent after" can be set to instant.
  • Each ring shows a small badge of the app it runs in (Orca, the Claude or Codex app, Terminal…), and the apps' rings show the conversation you last sent to.
  • A limits ring turns whenever its AI is at work, also while the Claude or Codex app is answering. Codex turns blue, the colour of its icon.
  • Under a limits ring, "PACE": how much you've used against an even week so far (under 100% is on track).

Fixed

  • "Connect" works for people who only use the Claude or ChatGPT/Codex app.
  • Sending to the Claude and Codex apps works in a new conversation, with the app minimized or just opened, and with the focus elsewhere in it.
  • No more "Resources" ring from the Codex app.
